meta.title: Optimize config.ini updates and efficiency improvements report
meta.body_summary: Batch up to 5 separate shell executions for AVD config.ini updates into a single command, reducing process spawns, and document other potential optimizations.

perf_labels.notes: Devin batched up to 5 shell execs into one; merged without review after 26 minutes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 190 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step performance optimization that was merged quickly with no review, consistent with low-risk nature.

review_details.performance_claim: Reduce shell executions from up to 5 to 1 when multiple AVD config options are set, eliminating process spawn overhead.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Batching shell commands in a CI runner is a straightforward optimization; no complex evidence required, aligning with small script-level changes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR explains the change but lacks runtime benchmarks; reproducibility of benefit relies on understanding shell execution counts.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions; PR was merged without any review feedback.

core_change_summary.description: In src/emulator-manager.ts, instead of conditionally appending to config.ini with separate shell calls for each setting, the PR collects all config entries into an array and writes them in one shell execution. The corresponding compiled JavaScript in lib/ is also updated.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: EFFICIENCY_REPORT.md was added with a comprehensive list of other potential improvements but was removed in a follow-up commit per request; the report content moved to PR description.
change_trajectory: Initial commit batched shell execs and added EFFICIENCY_REPORT.md.
Second commit removed report file and included compiled JS file.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by Devin with batched config optimization and efficiency report.
Maintainer ychescale9 merged PR without formal review after about 26 minutes.
